comment:
I think Section 1.2 makes a strong (too strong?) case on why the health sector needs more than foundational DPI - and I agree that the health sector has special needs. 
However, i think this section neglects how the health sector can benefit even from partial foundational DPI. As far as I see, foundational DPI are being built very rapidly (i would rephrase "DPIs do not yet exist" on line 192 - i think this is increasingly not true (https://dpimap.org/)).
For the ID function of the foundational DPI, the national ID number should be used as / linked to the health identifier when available; for patients that don't have a national ID number they can get a health-only number. You say this at the end of Box 1.2, but i think this point (i.e., health should use foundational DPI to the maximum potential and utility for the health sector) should be highlighted further / more prominent.
As an additional specific comment, i don't think that Line198 is what the foundational ID layer of DPI is trying to do - health specific data should stay in the health sector and not be in the foundational DPI.
